podcast.title: New York Trip and Bobby Orlando Meeting (1982)
podcast.body: In 1982, when they were very young and just starting out, Pechos Boys traveled to New York where they met producer Bobby Orlando (Bob-O). He introduced them to the suburban New York disco and gay community culture that had survived underground, profoundly influencing them. "cuando era muy jóvenes y aún estaban empezando en 1982 viaja a Nueva York y conocen a bobió Orlando a bobió."

podcast.title: Consistent Career Quality
podcast.body: Over 35 years since their first single, Pechos Boys have maintained an incredibly consistent career, with a unanimous consensus that they have never released a single bad album. They are considered one of the very few groups with such a long trajectory who have not experienced a "low period," consistently delivering recognized albums with great critical reception and quality. "son 35 años donde yo creo que un animamente se considera que los Pechos Boys no han sacado nion solo disco de mala calidad."

podcast.title: Musical Direction Prior to New York
podcast.body: Before their transformative trip to New York, Pechos Boys were "groping in the dark" (dando palos de ciego), interested in both rock and classical music but unsure of their definitive musical direction. The influences gained in New York with Bobby Orlando ultimately defined their group and shaped their entire career. "los Pechos Boys estaban un poco dando palos de ciego de aquellas porque les interesaba el rock, les interesaba la música clásica, no sabía muy bien."

podcast.title: Respected Career Trajectory
podcast.body: Pechos Boys are considered one of the most respected groups in music over the last 35 years, even by people who don't actively listen to them or have a special appreciation for their work. Their career is notably anomalous, maintaining a very characteristic and distinct style throughout, and is perceived as stable with little personal information known, focusing solely on their professional output. "son uno de los grupos más respetados en la música dentro de los últimos 35 años."

podcast.title: Revitalizing Disco in Europe
podcast.body: Upon returning to Europe from New York, Pechos Boys introduced a refined continuation of disco music, a genre that had not gained strong traction in Europe and had seemingly disappeared overnight. As skilled musicians, they polished the remnants of disco, stripping away its parodic or low-quality aspects to create a sophisticated and well-crafted version. "ellos vuelven a Europa y traen digamos que una continuidad de una música disco que a Europa no había llegado con mucha fuerza y que un día de la noche la mañana había desaparecido."

podcast.title: Role in Modern Music
podcast.body: Despite the distinctiveness of their music compared to prevailing trends, Pechos Boys played an important role in modern music, particularly in the 1980s and 1990s. Many recognize their significance, but few fully understand their exact importance or specific contribution to the music scene of those decades. "todo el mundo reconoce la importante labor de los Pechos Boys en la música moderna o lo importante que ha sido su trayectoria en los últimos 30, 35 años de música, a muy poca gente llega a entender exactamente por qué han sido tan importantes."

podcast.title: Solitary Musical Style
podcast.body: Pechos Boys are recognized for having defended a completely solitary style of music, operating distinctly and apart from other artists. This unique approach contributes to their historical importance, especially in the 1980s and 1990s, by offering a unique contribution to the music landscape. "un grupo que ha defendido un estilo de hacer la música completamente solitario y al margen del resto de artistas."

srcs.episode: Pet Shop Boys. Por qué son tan importantes?

podcast.title: Unique Market Niche
podcast.body: Pechos Boys emerged in the mid-1980s offering a polished and refined version of forgotten disco music, operating in a musical territory largely unexplored by others. This unique approach, presenting refined disco when the genre was practically out of the market, earned them significant respect and allowed them to establish a crucial market niche that grew in influence over the years. "se mueven en un campo en el que absolutamente nadie estaba trabajando."
